historical_growth.growth_rate_source: mid-cycle revenue growth. Through-cycle revenue CAGR is 5.1% (FY2015-FY2025) and 8.2% (FY2019-FY2025, trough-to-recovery); the 3-year figures are all measured from the FY2022 supercycle peak and the 5-year from the FY2020 upswing, so neither is a clean base. 4% is the long-run mid-cycle rate the base path decelerates to.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 10.4% is ~70% above revenue 5yr CAGR 6.1%: FY2021-FY2022 supercycle earnings (NT$140bn over two years) were retained ahead of the FY2023-FY2024 capex programme, and the 2026 UNIMICRON/NOVATEK fair-value and equity-method gains inflate the latest equity. Equity CAGR is NOT used as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less interest income): FY2020 35,694 / FY2022 59,603 / FY2025 46,361 (NT$m). Owner and reported FCF CAGRs are within 0.2pp of each other because SBC is <0.5% of revenue; the FY2022->FY2025 decline is capex (NT$83bn, 94bn, 91bn in FY2022-FY2024 for the Singapore and Tainan 22/28nm expansion) against revenue that fell 15% from the peak, not SBC. FY2023 reported FCF was -NT$8.0bn and FY2024 +NT$2.5bn; the series is cyclical and capex-timed, which is why the forward build uses components and a 10-year horizon.

scenario_narratives.base: Cycle recovery into FY2027 with modest pricing uplift, then mean reversion to UMC's through-cycle ~44% EBITDA margin and ~3% growth; capex normalises to roughly D&A by Y7; FCF margin matures at ~16%. Value is dominated by the terminal (14x cap) and the NT$380bn+ of net cash, time deposits, securities and the UNIMICRON/FARADAY associate stakes outside the operating model.
scenario_narratives.bull: Structural re-rating of mature-node foundry: pricing power from 22/28nm scarcity and AI-adjacent specialty (>US$1bn by FY2029), Chinese capacity absorbed, margin settles 2pp above the old cycle average with continued growth capex; 16x terminal on 2.5% growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2028 downcycle meets Chinese 28-90nm overcapacity; margin troughs at 37% while new fabs depreciate; pricing never recovers above 41% EBITDA; capex cut to 22%; 12x terminal on 1.5% growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A capital-intensive, cyclical, trailing-edge foundry valued on mid-cycle owner FCF, not on the current up-cycle quarter. The operating business is worth its normalised ~NT$55-65bn of mature FCF capitalised at a cyclical 12-16x; on top sits a large non-operating balance -- ~NT$147bn of cash and time deposits, ~NT$51bn of securities and ~NT$275bn (pre-tax, filed June fair value) of quoted associate stakes dominated by UNIMICRON -- which is credited once in the bridge, at fair value less tax, and whose income is stripped from the flows. FCF is built from components (EBITDA margin, D&A, capex, cash tax, working capital) over 10 years because the FY2027 capex spike means the Y1-Y3 margin is not a steady state. SBC is immaterial (<0.5% of revenue) so house and street values nearly coincide. Risk is charged once, in the scenario flows and weights, with a single TWD-built 8% WACC.
key_risks_to_valuation: Chinese mature-node (28-90nm) overcapacity: SMIC/Hua Hong price discounts of 30-40% have already forced UMC to seek ~15% supplier cost cuts; a renewed price war is the bear case and the single largest driver of the bear/base gap.

Capex timing and returns: ~US$5bn committed for 2026-27 (Singapore 12i P3/P4, Tainan advanced packaging) ahead of demand; if the AI-adjacent specialty ramp (>US$1bn by ~FY2029) disappoints, depreciation rises into a soft market and the FY2028-30 margins fall below the base path.

UNIMICRON stake volatility: ~NT$208bn after-tax in the bridge (~NT$16.6 per common share, ~US$2.6 per ADS, ~10% of the price). A 50% drawdown in 3037.TW removes ~US$1.3/ADS of value; it is a real but non-operating and illiquid asset.
Currency: >50% of revenue is USD-priced against mostly TWD costs; a stronger TWD compresses TWD margins (partially hedged), and the ADS value also moves 1:1 with USD/TWD.
Customer concentration (top-10 ~57%, largest ~12%) and limited backlog visibility make single-quarter revenue swings of 10-20% normal.
US-China export controls on the Xiamen (USC) and Suzhou (HJTC) fabs and cross-strait geopolitical risk are tail risks sitting outside the three scenarios.

Terminal-value dependence: ~55% of operating EV is the terminal; the 14x cap binds in the base case (Gordon at 8%/2% would be ~17x), so the value is a judgment about what a buyer pays for mature-node capacity in 2036, not a growth story.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 6.97-28.96 USD per ADS. Home listing 2303.TW used for the FX parity check in inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: UMC_Metrics.csv / UMC.duckdb core_metrics (20-F FY2016-FY2025 annual, 6-K quarterly to Q2 2026, IFRS, NT$ millions); 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet, share count, lease, investment and dividend lines read directly from UMC_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt; FX from Yahoo TWD=X.
data_sources.qualitative: UMC_Analysis.json (2026-10-04): Q2 2026 earnings call guidance (29-Jul-2026), capex programme, node/end-market mix, Chinese foundry pricing, GlobalFoundries approach reports.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E. H1 2026 actual NT$129,771m (Q1 61,038 + Q2 68,733; 6-K Q2-2026). Q3 guided wafer shipments up high-single-digit sequentially with USD ASP flat-to-slightly-up (Q2-2026 call, 29-Jul-2026) -> ~NT$74bn; Q4 assumed flat-to-slightly-down seasonally (~NT$72bn). FY2026E ~NT$276bn, +16% on FY2025 actual NT$237,553m. The growth path compounds from this estimate; Y1 = FY2027.
inputs.ads_ratio_note: 1 ADS = 5 common shares (NYSE ADR programme; 20-F cover). Numeric so sanity_check.py's multiples() can divide core_metrics' ordinary-share-basis shares_outstanding by it to match the per-ADS USD quote -- a string here is silently unparsed by _num() and the ADS adjustment never applies.
inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-EQUIVALENTS, millions. Fully diluted weighted-average common shares for Q2 2026 = 12,541,653 thousand (6-K Q2-2026 EPS note: 12,475,080 basic + 54,728 restricted stock + 11,845 employee compensation), divided by 5 common shares per ADS = 2,508.33m ADS. Cross-check: FY2025 cash dividend NT$32,704m / NT$2.60808 per share = 12,540m entitled shares. The Metrics.csv SharesOutstanding of 12,342.6m (20-F FY2025) is a lower, basic-type count; the diluted Q2 2026 figure is used because it is later and more conservative. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The Q2 2026 treasury-stock buyback (NT$3,096m) is the cash mechanism holding the count flat, not an extra reduction.
inputs.total_debt_note: 30-Jun-2026 (6-K Q2-2026 balance sheet, NT$ thousands -> millions): short-term loans 2,807 + bonds payable incl. current portion 39,640 + long-term loans incl. current portion 15,085 = 57,532. Lease liabilities (5,917) EXCLUDED: leases are charged as an operating cost in the flows (treatment B).
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents only, 30-Jun-2026. Time deposits classified as financial assets at amortized cost (22,136) are carried separately in equity_bridge so the reader can see each component.
inputs.fcf_basis: LTM to 30-Jun-2026 = FY2025 (OCF 99,864 - capex 50,734 = 49,131) + H1 2026 (OCF 55,679 - capex 22,688 = 32,991) - H1 2025 (OCF 45,924 - capex 23,070 = 22,854) = 59,268 reported; less LTM SBC 539 and LTM interest income 2,027 = 56,702 owner FCF. CAUTION: H1 2026 capex (NT$22.7bn) ran at well under half the ~US$2.0bn (~NT$63bn) FY2026 guidance, so H2 2026 is capex-heavy and FY2026E owner FCF is nearer NT$40bn than the LTM figure. The forward build is from components, not from this anchor.
inputs.sbc_source: Cash-flow statement 'Share-based payment' add-back: FY2025 NT$491m (20-F FY2025), H1 2026 NT$475m, H1 2025 NT$427m (6-K Q2-2026). No separately disclosed cash tax on equity awards (restricted-stock plans are issued gratuitously, no net-share settlement withholding line). SBC is ~0.2-0.4% of revenue; immaterial but kept visible.
inputs.buyback_note: Treasury stock acquired NT$3,096m in Q2 2026 (first repurchase since FY2020); FY2021-FY2025 nil. Dividends are the main capital-return channel: NT$35,788m paid FY2025, NT$32,704m declared for FY2025 earnings and paid 30-Jul-2026.
inputs.fx_note: Model in TWD, outputs converted to USD per ADS. fx_rate is model -> quote: 1 TWD = 0.031450 USD, i.e. USD/TWD 31.796 (Yahoo Finance TWD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-02T20:38Z). Per-share values are computed per ADS-equivalent (5 common shares, see share_count_basis), so intrinsic_value is USD per UMC ADS and directly comparable to current_price. Parity check against the home listing: the NYSE close at inputs.price_as_of divided by 5 and multiplied by 31.796 gives NT$167.1 per common share against the TWSE 2303.TW close of NT$161.5 on 2026-10-02 (regularMarketTime 2026-10-02T05:30Z) -- a 3.5% ADR premium, consistent with Taipei closing ~12 hours before New York on a strong US semiconductor session. Twin field weighted_iv_twd (per common share) is emitted by the build. NOTE on the twins: because shares_outstanding is in ADS-equivalents, every *_twd field (intrinsic_value_twd, weighted_iv_twd, entry_price_twd) is TWD per ADS-equivalent, i.e. per 5 common shares; divide by 5 for the per-common-share figure comparable to the 2303.TW quote.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:02Z regular close (Friday; valuation written Sunday 2026-10-04, no after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in TWD, the currency of the flows: Taiwan 10-year government bond ~1.6% + 5.5% equity risk premium x beta 1.15 (foundry; cyclicality is already priced in the probability-weighted flows, so no ad-hoc premium) = ~7.9% cost of equity; ~NT$57.5bn of debt at ~1.5-2% after tax against a ~NT$2tn market cap moves the blend by <0.2pp. WACC 8.0% in all three scenarios -- risk is charged once, in the flows. Terminal growth 2.0% base (TWD inflation ~1.5-2% plus modest real growth for a mature-node foundry facing Chinese capacity additions). Terminal cap 14x FCF in base (cyclical, 12-15x band), 16x bull, 12x bear.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Lease cash cost = principal NT$420m per half-year (financing: 'Cash payments for the principal portion of the lease liability', 6-K Q2-2026) + ~NT$0.1bn/yr lease interest = ~NT$0.95bn/yr = 0.35% of FY2026E revenue, charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (NT$5,917m) are therefore excluded from total_debt. Right-of-use depreciation (~NT$0.8bn/yr, ~0.3% of revenue) is left inside da_pct_path; the double-count is 0.3% x 18% tax = ~0.05% of revenue, below the precision of the margin paths.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests NT$4m at 30-Jun-2026 (down from NT$87m at FY2025 after subsidiary buy-ins); flows are modelled on the consolidated basis and the NT$4m stock is deducted in equity_bridge. Immaterial either way.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (routing table: operating company, non-US and cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). Pure-play foundry with transactional wafer revenue; no bank, REIT or holdco features; the equity-method and FVOCI investment portfolio is handled under the matching-asset rule (income stripped from EBITDA, assets added in equity_bridge at fair value) rather than by valuing UMC as a holdco. CYCLE: FY2026 is a recovery year (utilization 79% -> 85% -> guided >90%, GM to mid-30s); the base case lets FY2027 carry management's 'more meaningful pricing uplift' and then mean-reverts EBITDA margin to the FY2019-FY2025 through-cycle average (~44%) by Y5 rather than extrapolating the Q3 2026 run-rate. CAPEX: FY2026 ~US$2.0bn (~NT$63bn, ~23% of revenue) and ~US$5bn board-approved across 2026-2027 (Singapore Fab 12i P3/P4, Tainan advanced-packaging fab) -> Y1 FY2027 capex 33% of revenue, fading to a ~23% maintenance-plus-growth level roughly equal to D&A by Y7. TIMING: FY0 is FY2026E; the balance sheet is 30-Jun-2026 adjusted for the NT$32.7bn dividend payable that was paid 30-Jul-2026. H2 2026 free cash flow (after ~NT$40bn of H2 capex, likely NT$5-15bn) is not counted anywhere -- a small conservative omission. SBC-ZERO-ish market: SBC is ~0.3% of revenue, so the house/street band is very narrow (band_position will be close to meaningless; read the house figure). INTEREST INCOME stripped (net cash + time deposits ~NT$147bn vs ~NT$57bn debt) and the cash pile credited once in the bridge. RISK charged once: identical 8% WACC in all scenarios; cyclicality, China mature-node overcapacity and Taiwan tail risk are in the scenario flows and weights.

bear.narrative: The 2026 recovery is an inventory restock, not a new cycle: FY2027 grows 3% as the pricing uplift fails to materialise, then a FY2028 downturn (-8%, like FY2023's -20% but shallower) coincides with SMIC/Hua Hong mature-node capacity coming on at 30-40% discounts, forcing UMC to match on 28-90nm. EBITDA margin troughs at 37% (FY2019 was 36.6% at the last trough) with the new Singapore and Tainan fabs depreciating into a soft market, and only recovers to 41%. Capex is cut hard after the committed FY2027 spend (22% of revenue). A top-10 customer migrating 22nm volume to a Chinese foundry or a US export-control tightening on the Xiamen/Suzhou fabs would deepen this path. Terminal 12x on 1.5% growth. Cross-strait disruption is a tail outside all three scenarios.

base.narrative: FY2027 carries the guided pricing uplift and the Singapore P3 ramp on >90% utilization (+8%, EBITDA margin 47%, a shade above the H1 2026 45% and below the FY2022 peak 53%); growth then decelerates to a 2.5-3% mid-cycle rate and the margin mean-reverts to the FY2019-FY2025 average of ~44% by Y5 as Chinese 28-90nm capacity caps pricing. Capex 33% of revenue in FY2027 (the second half of the ~US$5bn 2026-27 programme), fading to 23% by Y7, roughly equal to D&A (22-23%) -- the fab base is maintained, not expanded, in the terminal state. Cash tax 17% -> 18% (Taiwan 20% statutory, R&D credits, Pillar Two 15% floor; FY2024-FY2025 book rates 16-17%). Working capital absorbs 5% of incremental revenue (receivables + inventory ~NT$77bn exceed payables; customer prepayments offset part). Terminal FCF margin ~16%, capped at 14x FCF.

bull.narrative: The 2027 pricing uplift is a real step-change (double-digit ASP gains as in 2021-22, not low single digits), the AI-adjacent specialty platforms (power management, silicon photonics, advanced packaging, FPGA) reach the >US$1bn target by FY2029, and Chinese foundries stay full (>95% utilization) so 28nm pricing holds. Revenue +12%/+10% in FY2027-28, EBITDA margin peaks at 50% (still below the FY2022 53%) and settles at 46% -- a structurally better mix (22/28nm 37% of revenue and rising, automotive/industrial 19%) earns ~2pp over the old cycle average. Growth capex continues (30% in FY2028) and is rewarded. Terminal 16x on 2.5% growth.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the Analysis JSON grades cyclicality, Chinese mature-node pricing pressure, capex-ahead-of-demand, US-China export controls and Taiwan concentration all 'high', the ~US$5bn 2026-27 capex is being committed before the AI-adjacent specialty demand is proven, and the ADR has nearly quadrupled from its 52-week low on a single recovery year. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right at once -- a double-digit 2027 price uplift, the specialty ramp to >US$1bn, and Chinese foundries not re-opening a price war -- and UMC has never sustained a >46% EBITDA margin outside the 2021-22 shortage. Base 50% unchanged.
probability_weighted.band_note: band_position is degenerate (thousands of percent) and should be read as n/a: SBC is ~0.3% of revenue, so the house and street values differ by ~1.4% and the accounting-regime band collapses to a point. UMC is effectively an SBC-zero filer; read the house figure. The price sits far above both ends of the band.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
